metadata.name: routed-smoke
metadata.description: Create a citation-backed finding through the routed test API, then verify it appears on the findings page. Workflow Health must install a test-storage lease before execution; its teardown counters verify no primary-storage writes.

evaluate.expression: (async () => { const response = await fetch('/vrooli.web_search.v1.findings.FindingsService/AddFinding', {method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json','X-Vrooli-Test-Mode':'1'},body:JSON.stringify({claim:'routed-smoke-001: isolated web-search finding',confidence:0.8,query:'routed browser validation',source:'FINDING_SOURCE_MANUAL',citations:[{url:'https://example.com/routed-validation',title:'Isolated test fixture'}]})}); if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Routed fixture creation failed: '+response.status); const body = await response.json(); if (!body.finding?.id) throw new Error('Fixture ID missing'); return body.finding.id; })()

metadata.label: Seed one finding in the leased test database

assert.failure_message: Seeded fixture 'routed-smoke-001' not visible in the list — the UI->API request did not reach the routed test pool. Check that X-Vrooli-Test-Mode is being attached by Playwright (browser_profile.extra_headers), that TestModeMiddleware is mounted, and that the list's repository uses *database.RoutedDB.

metadata.label: Assert seeded slug is rendered (proves routing end-to-end)
